name: Frame Window
description: Frame window analysis for replays, with an optional Click Between Frames (CBF) mode. Open with Ctrl + Right Alt.

cbf-windows.name: CBF windows
cbf-windows.description: Measure sub-frame (CBF) windows instead of whole frames. Needs Click Between Frames. The in-game sub-frame trial is not written yet.

instant-restart.name: Instant restart
instant-restart.description: Restart the level straight away instead of waiting for the usual restart animation. Analysis already skips restarts by loading checkpoints. This setting will apply to real-time playback.

y-tolerance.name: Y tolerance
y-tolerance.description: How far (game units) the player's y may drift from the replay and still count as a match. One frame of drift is about 1.6 units in the test replay.
